typeDefinitions.Identity: System.String, Validation.ValidId: ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_.-], length1..96. Empty only where explicitly the native sentinel; null is not empty. Identity conveys no permission.

typeDefinitions.Revision: System.Int64; expected command revision matches current for fresh commands, native principal-bound duplicate route separate.
typeDefinitions.Quantity: RuleQuantity: normalized nonnegative Int64 Numerator and positive Int64 Denominator. No floating conversion, minimum positive quantum, rounding or arbitrary mass/count conversion.
typeDefinitions.Time: RuleTime: exact nonnegative normalized Int64 numerator/denominator, seconds. Durations are computed facts, not writable command fields.
typeDefinitions.NullablePayload: Actual reference null differs from an object whose fields are zero/empty.

derivedIdentityRules.CARE: Actual WoundTreatmentRecord.Id = WoundTreatmentStation.Prefix + Basket decimal (0/1); .claim-{index0..5}, .healer/.patient, critical gain .gain/.gain.point. LongRest Id=TEST_ONLY.cleric-long-rest.{sequence0..1023} + .occupancy. conditionalObligationDefinitions.ORDINARY_PAID_HANDLING: If native ordinary branch is eligible, commit attempts one second of shared time/work; known deadline blockers remain initial constraints. conditionalObligationDefinitions.TACTICAL_INTERACTION: Only admitted own regular turn; current interaction count0 uses first interaction, count1 requires unspent permitted Action and consumes second interaction+Action, count>=2 unavailable. conditionalObligationDefinitions.TREATMENT_COMPLETION: Native active work advances through shared clock. Recheck actual source age/access/condition/stock at endpoint; only actual endpoint check consumes RNG and determines outcome. No predicted roll or successful preservation.
conditionalObligationDefinitions.PENDING_CONTINUATION: Resolving real pending Strain point may resume actual retained suspended clock/manufacturing target after the removal. Subsequent event/check/choice may suspend or fail according to native transaction; not an invented duration/extra allowance.
